# Feature: Twin lock — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #11 (Twin lock) from Keys and Locks before it is used in real levels. Effect: needs two keys of its colour. Unique: consumes two matching keys, not one. Useful: makes duplicate keys and inventory space matter. Source status in the candidate file is 'trial'.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** needs two keys of its colour.

**So that** makes duplicate keys and inventory space matter.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets Twin lock for the first time in its teaching room (mech-11-twin-lock-room). Teaching moment: First room: a twin lock with both its keys in the room and a single lock of the same colour beyond it. A player who presses into the twin lock holding both keys, because it is the first lock they meet, spends both on it and cannot open the single lock, so the restart teaches that a twin lock's cost is counted before it is paid. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Press into it holding one matching key and it shows it still needs one more, consuming nothing
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Press holding two matching keys and both are consumed and the lock dissolves to floor

## Edge Cases & Rules

- Press holding two matching keys and both are consumed and the lock dissolves to floor
- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees Twin lock's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Level JSON: new Test Level mech-11-twin-lock-room (rows + legend) implementing the teaching moment above.
- Sprites/defs: reuse existing tiles where the mechanic reuses an existing tile; add a new sprite/tile def only if this mechanic introduces a new tile (confirm in the implement task).
- Source: plans/level-design/candidate-mechanics/keys-and-locks.yml mechanic #11.
